recipes.name: Chicken Biryani (Extreme)
recipes.notes: Medium-hot, layered dum biryani. Use aged basmati; kewra at the end.

recipes.name: Chicken Yakhni Pulao
recipes.notes: Mild, whole-spice yakhni. Strain stock well for clear grains.

recipes.name: Red Beans (Lal Lobia Masala)
recipes.notes: Soak beans overnight; boil 45-50 min until tender. Protein-packed.

recipes.name: Chicken Karahi (Fire)
recipes.notes: Hot & spicy. Authentic karahi = tomatoes and ginger, no onion.

recipes.name: Chicken Qorma
recipes.notes: Shadi-style qorma; fried onion + kewra finish. Ghee makes it.

recipes.name: Daal Chana (Masala)
recipes.notes: Soak 30 min. Finish with cumin + curry leaf tarka.

recipes.name: Daal Mash with Tadka
recipes.notes: Dry-style mash daal; ginger julienne + butter tadka on top.

recipes.name: Daal Masoor (Malka)
recipes.notes: Everyday comfort daal; squeeze of lemon lifts it.

recipes.name: Beef Salan (Aloo Gosht, Delhi)
recipes.notes: Classic shorba-wala salan; slow-cook beef till tender.

recipes.name: Shami Kabab
recipes.notes: Makes 12-14; freeze extras. Wash daal, don't soak it.

recipes.name: Chicken Manchurian
recipes.notes: Desi-Chinese; sweet, hot & sour. Pair with fried rice (R010).

recipes.name: Chinese Fried Rice
recipes.notes: Day-old boiled rice gives the best texture.

recipes.name: One Pot Spicy Pasta
recipes.notes: Weeknight one-pot; dial chilli up or down.

recipes.name: Chicken Macaroni (Korma-style)
recipes.notes: Food Fusion's korma masala served over boiled macaroni - desi twist.

recipes.name: Bhindi (Masala Aloo Bhindi)
recipes.notes: Dry bhindi; lemon at the end keeps it crisp, not slimy.

recipes.name: Gobi Masala (Dhaba Style)
recipes.notes: Dhaba-style gobi with aloo & carrot; don't overcook the florets.

recipes.name: Karela (Qeema Karelay)
recipes.notes: Salt & rest karela 1-2 hrs, then wash well to tame bitterness.

recipes.name: Aalu (Masala Aloo)
recipes.notes: Quick potato bhujia; lovely with puri, daal-chawal or paratha.

recipes.name: Qeema (Dhaba Style Aloo Qeema)
recipes.notes: Dhaba-style; methi (fenugreek) finish is the secret.

recipes.name: Beef Nihari
recipes.notes: Slow-cooked shank; serve with ginger julienne, green chilli, lemon & naan.

recipes.name: Khichri (Spicy Fried Khichdi)
recipes.notes: Comfort in a bowl; serve with raita and achar.

recipes.name: Saag (Sarson Ka Saag)
recipes.notes: Slow-cook 2-3 hrs; serve with makai ki roti & white butter.
